metric_definitions.standing: original cmd.is_standing_env profile0, NOT complement of moving, and not every actual zero-command instant
metric_definitions.straight_zero: profile2 exact continuous sampled vx==0; no exposure here is not lack of source standing/transition-stop exposure
metric_definitions.transition_sign: original signed_yaw INITIAL sign; actual reference reverses at6s, not current yaw sign
metric_definitions.world_progress: ONLY completed live sampled >=2pi net-signed-yaw windows with same commandUID/profile/episode/warmup-or-steady phase; actual projected displacement/time
metric_definitions.reference: time-integral of original body command projected along fixed world direction; ideal instantaneous projection is cos^2, not constant .5
metric_definitions.event_vs_unique: signed turn/window events can repeat within same env/command; unique IDs are reported independently perprofile; cross-profile unions not saved

source_cycle_definition: actual same command_uid/profile/episode/phase live sampled window with net signed yaw>=2pi; endpoints quantized to20ms, no interpolated subcycles; time and displacement sums provided
checks: one exact final profile saved text
selected saved text full byte SHA
profile source and no inherited graduation
do not add perprofile IDs as distinct population
pending_original_skill_conditions: No original formal success tolerance/pass rule is recorded here; do not invent a threshold from MAE or positive progress
Progress values condition on completed windows, not every moving control or whole command; unfinished tails/resamples/phase boundaries not graded
Per-command-instance counts/IDs/success distributions are not in the saved summary; raw commandUID traces were NOT decoded
Per-env continuous-exposure maxima and full motion are not in this saved summary; NPZ/gz were NOT opened
Transition phase exposure exists, but phase-specific start/brake/stop/reversal tracking errors and a single-command full12s pass are not saved
Source standing flag differs from all actual zero command; an independently zero-command-filtered metric is unavailable
Command amplitude/world-direction/DR/action/queue/reset domain histograms and per-env physical constraints are not certified by this summary
Ordinary termination-based resets are excluded by source window logic; summary alone does not audit every possible within-control health reset
